name: fresh-context-contract
proxy: Node fetch strips Origin; browser CORS checked separately after publishing
target: every successful upload-to-visible-result < 30000 ms; p95 < 30000 ms; no errors; injection and scanned annex retained
cache: new Chromium process and context each run; OS filesystem warm; no tab inspection cache
symbols: production JS + source maps; third-party OCR Wasm has no debug symbols
unavailable: per-worker V8 heap: page CDP metrics omit workers
per-core attribution: aggregate process snapshots only
isolation: no tests/builds during browser inspection; ordinary host power settings unchanged
